hooks.name: VibeMon - Session Start
hooks.description: Send the start state to VibeMon when a session begins

hooks.name: VibeMon - Prompt Submit
hooks.description: Send the thinking state to VibeMon when a prompt is submitted

hooks.name: VibeMon - Tool Use
hooks.description: Send the working state to VibeMon before a tool runs

hooks.name: VibeMon - Tool Complete
hooks.description: Return VibeMon to thinking after a tool finishes

hooks.name: VibeMon - Stop
hooks.description: Send the done state to VibeMon when the agent finishes responding
